notes: Shopify storefront (serax.com). Checked main nav, mega-menu, footer, /pages listing, and the full sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1/2.xml + /collections.json (3137 unique collections total, all paged), plus site's own /search/suggest.json for 'outlet', 'clearance', 'archive sale', 'sale', 'opruiming' (NL), 'soldes'/'destockage' (FR). Direct probes of /collections/outlet, /clearance, /final-sale, /end-of-line, /last-chance, /discontinued all 404 -- no collection uses those exact terms. 'clearance' and 'outlet' search terms returned zero collections/pages (only a few unrelated products matched by body-text coincidence, ignored). SALE/CLEARANCE VS PROMO REASONING: found a genuine, evergreen 'Archive Sale' program with its own dedicated landing page at /pages/archive-sale (title 'Archive Sale', on-page heading 'SALE UP TO 50% / ARCHIVE SALE', tagline 'Designer Collection'), which links out to 4 permanent category-scoped collections (Tableware/Home Accessories/Lighting/Furniture). This is the site's own taxonomy for permanently marked-down past-season/discontinued designer stock (an 'archive' = old/discontinued stock, not a live-season item), and it is NOT a one-off campaign: the 4 category collections were published 2025-11-14, and a further dated batch (archive-sale-jul26-30) was published 2026-07-06, showing the program is actively refreshed over time rather than a single expired promotion. This clears the brief's bar for genuine Clearance/Outlet taxonomy (distinct from a temporary seasonal Sale). Recorded as a grouping row (the /pages/archive-sale hub) + 4 real children, each counted by exhaustive /collections/<handle>/products.json pagination (unique product IDs), not the (often-inflated) products_count field, consistent with this company's prior extraction pass. A 5th, dated sub-batch collection (archive-sale-jul26-30) was also checked and is currently EMPTY (0 unique product IDs) -- dropped per the zero-product rule, noted here as evidence the rotation is ongoing. EXCLUDED as generic temporary promotional sale, not Clearance, per the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance test: 4 Black-Friday-named collections found via the same sitemap sweep -- black-friday-2025 (255 products, live), bf24-30 ('Discover the Serax Black Friday discounts up to 30%', 0 products, expired), bf25-20 and bf25-50 (both 0 products, expired). These are explicitly Black-Friday-branded, campaign-dated, temporary percent-off promotions with no permanence/outlet signal in their own naming or copy -- classic Sale, not Clearance, so left out entirely (no ambiguous flag needed, the Black Friday branding is unambiguous).
